title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives v_C = 5 m/s using centripetal force condition at point C (mg = mv_C^2/R).

title: Force at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the supporting force at point B as 6.0 N (or equivalent expression).

title: Height H
description: Essential: Correctly determines the vertical height H from O to A as 3.36 m (or equivalent expression).

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly between relevant points (e.g., A to B or A to C).

title: Velocity decomposition at A
description: Important: Correctly resolves the velocity at point A into components using the given 53° angle.

title: Kinematics for vertical motion
description: Important: Uses appropriate kinematics (v_y^2 = 2gH) to find H from the vertical velocity component at A.

title: Geometry interpretation
description: Optional: Correctly interprets the circular arc geometry (127° removed, 53° from vertical at A).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, kg, s, N) throughout the solution.

title: Sign/direction error in force
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign in force balance at B (e.g., forgetting that both weight and centripetal force contribute to normal force).

title: Energy conservation misapplication
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies energy conservation (e.g., missing potential energy terms or using wrong height differences).
